CustomField.description: FB-798 spec (Ramp MRC and TCV Calculation Spec): the incremental MRC this specific ramp order/line adds, NOT the running total. Computed by OrderMrcRollupService as (Quantity * UnitPrice) minus the same value from the linked prior phase's OrderItem (via Ramp_Linked_Phase__c), or minus the immediately preceding phase's amount for aggregate products (Product2.Merge_IB_Task__c = true), regardless of linking. Zero if unchanged from the prior phase. Full (Quantity * UnitPrice) if this is the first phase for this product (no prior phase to net against). Used for commissions, bookings, and revenue recognition reporting — distinct from MRC_Amount__c, which is the line's own face-value monthly charge.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Incremental MRC this ramp order adds (delta from the prior phase), not the running total. Auto-calculated - do not edit manually.
CustomField.label: Order MRC (Delta)
